statement: Every wasm_operations journal row carries an owner node identity, boot incarnation, fence, lease, and stage: a crash inside the IN_PROGRESS window leaves the idempotency identity recoverable through safe fenced takeover of stale CLAIMED rows by a live owner — building on the landed node-incarnation fencing plumbing — instead of permanently poisoning that invocation identity, and the invocation-journal-owner-recovery scenario is green.

constraints.statement: Owner fencing reuses the landed node-incarnation plumbing (nodes table incarnation, heartbeat fencing); no second incarnation domain or fencing mechanism is introduced.
Stale-row takeover is fenced and incarnation-checked; a live original owner must never lose its row to a racing taker.
